headline: Agility Robotics goes public on the Nasdaq
summary: Agility Robotics began trading on the Nasdaq as the first publicly traded pure-play humanoid robotics company. Ars Technica frames the debut as inviting scrutiny of the broader humanoid robot market, describing Agility as a US leader in deploying the machines.
